new_entities.name: Modafinil used off-label
new_entities.description: Wake-promoting medication used by healthy people off-label for alertness and cognitive enhancement.

new_entities.name: Sustained attention in healthy adults
new_entities.description: Sustained attention or vigilance performance measured in healthy adults without a clinical sleep or attention disorder.

edges.population: healthy adults, especially under sleep loss or high cognitive demand
edges.mechanism: Modafinil promotes wakefulness through catecholaminergic and other arousal-related circuits that can stabilize vigilance and response control. In healthy adults, the clearest benefits appear in attention-demanding settings or under sleep-pressure, while broader claims of generalized enhancement remain more controversial.
edges.summary: Modafinil likely does improve sustained attention in healthy adults, but the effect is context-dependent and not as universally impressive as its reputation suggests. Evidence is strongest under sleep deprivation or high-load tasks, while benefits in fully rested healthy users are more modest and selective.
edges.caveats: This is a prescription drug with real side-effect, sleep, and misuse considerations, not a benign supplement. Positive attention effects do not automatically imply that healthy off-label use is worth the risk or appropriate outside medical supervision.
